about_the_game:
This is an idle game with rich skill development and upgrade elements.

Gameplay

There is a mysterious cube placed in the center of the island. Click on it~ No matter why. Lead your little rock figures and attack it! Every time you hit it, the cube will pour out all kinds of rare items like a treasure, which will become the cornerstone of the tribe's development.

Little Rock Figures

The little rock figures each have a unique mission. The porters are responsible for collecting the precious dropped items; the boxers are incredibly strong and attack the mysterious cube. Little figures of different occupations unlock skills, upgrade talents, and keep growing along their respective career planning routes.

The Rock Tribe

Here, rare items are skillfully processed and manufactured into various props to assist the adventures and construction of the little rock figures. The Stone Altar can provide a rich selection of talent combinations.

Game Features

Collect and explore as many resources as possible, and choose efficient collection methods and skill synergy effects.

  • Exquisite pixel art presentation

  • Have a surprising experience different from ordinary idle games, with rich and diverse growth paths

  • Strategically choose talent skills

  • Provide challenge items to unlock special abilities

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: Explore the mystery of the mysterious cube at the center of Boulder Island, dig out endless treasures, wake up the sleeping little boulder people, and lead them to create prosperity!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
